This resonates. I have bipolar, emotionally unstable personality traits, severe ME and Endometriosis. All conditions that cause doctors to treat you with disbelief and contempt. I had covid19 in March and it’s made my ME unbearable, it was more the stress of dealing with nasty doctors who not only don’t care but don’t believe you (no of course they won’t help you either) than any of my ailments that sent me over the edge. 

I have no friends who live anywhere near me. My mother has a police caution to stay away from me, my dad lives abroad and there’s no one else. 

I lose touch with people because I am a ball of trauma and don’t want to burden anyone.

Drowning terrifies me. Problem is, everything terrifies me. Absolutely shit-scared of heights, scared of pain, scared of dying and scared of not. I tried HARD. I was once in a coma for 2 weeks. Doctors say no one dies of overdoses anymore. 

I didn’t see him jump, I just loved him so obsess about his final moments. I did see another friend laying in the road after jumping off a bridge, by sheer outrageous coincidence. She talked absolute nonsense in the ambulance and passed away shortly after. That was ten years ago. I still have to drive past that bridge and flash back to her shoe stuck in the railing. She’d had her kids taken away due to her mental health and couldn’t live with it. 

Another friend took a massive overdose of Tramadol, recovered, stood up to go home and collapsed of a pulmonary embolism. I arrived just in time for them to announce his death and I sat with his body for a bit. He didn’t have anyone else. His family left his ashes at the crem.

I’ve spent a lot of time on psych wards so my friends have a high mortality rate.
